newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian Sept wage inflation 3.6 pct - Istat.
newsitem.headline: Italian Sept wage inflation 3.6 pct - Istat.

text.p: Italian wage inflation stood at an
annual 3.6 percent in September, statistics institute ISTAT said
ISTAT said it had calculated the figures using a new base

Istat said wage inflation in the agriculture sector rose 0.8 percent year-on-year in September, 2.7 percent in the industrial sector, 4.6 percent in the chemical sector, 1.6 percent in the metal workers sector, 3.4 percent in the service sector and 2.5 percent in the transport and communications sector.
The statistics office added that the number of hours lost to industrial action in the first eight months of 1996 was a provisional 2.1 million hours from 4.4 million in the same 1995 period.
